help.title: Help — Settings
help.overview_text: The Settings page centralises personal preferences and administrative features. Adjust the language, visual theme and interface scale. Access your profile, view your feedbacks and, if you are an administrator, access system logs.
help.step_preferences: Preferences — adjust the language, theme (light/dark/auto) and interface scale
help.step_account: Account — access your profile to view and edit your personal details (name, email, photo, etc.)
help.step_mail: Email — connect your integrated email account (email and password only; servers pre-defined)
help.step_feedbacks: My Feedbacks — view the status of bugs, suggestions or improvements you have submitted (collapsible section)
help.step_admin: Administration (ADMIN only) — access system logs to view all recorded actions
help.tip_text: Use the feedback button in the bottom-right corner of the application to submit suggestions or report issues at any time.

mail.readonly_hint: Fixed settings — read only. The connection always uses TLS.
